verdict.rationale: Pydantic AI is a Python framework whose agents run in your own environment. The docs say the same agent runs behind a web frontend, in the terminal, on a background queue, or as a plain object you call run() on. The CLI can also spin up a local uvicorn server, and the Logfire cloud integration is explicitly optional, so the core runs on infrastructure you control. Missing for 10: an explicit open-source license or self-hosting statement, first-party self-hosting or deployment documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration of self-hosted operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: The same agent runs everywhere you need it: behind a web frontend, in the terminal, on a voice call, on a durable background queue, or as a plain object you call run() on.
spin up a uvicorn server to chat with your Pydantic AI agents from your browser
Pydantic AI has built-in (but optional) support for Logfire.
